body:
Kedimiz Robin’in GIF'ini oluştur. Kameraya baksın göz tek gözünü kırpsın ve kafasına Robin yazan bir şapka düşsün.

Üretim uyarlaması: Bu çağrıda GIF değil, 4 sütun ve 3 satırdan oluşan tek PNG sprite sayfası üret. Toplam 12 eşit kare, zaman sırası soldan sağa ve üstten alta. Kenarlık, ayraç çizgisi, boş oluk, zaman etiketi veya kare numarası yok. Sabit kamera, aynı karakter boyutu, aynı arka plan ve renkler. Her karede gerçek ve farklı ardışık hareket. Kareler daha sonra GIF olarak kodlanacak.
12 karede: Robin kameraya bakar; tek gözünü kırpar; tekrar açar; yukarıdan üzerinde tam olarak 'Robin' yazan küçük yeşil şapka iner; başına konar; sonra hafifçe yukarı sıçrayıp kadraj dışına çıkar ve ilk duruma döner. Şapka üzerindeki yazı dışında hiçbir yazı veya kare numarası yok.

en.body:
## How to use

Upload the 1 project-generated reference image(s) in the displayed order (R16), then use the complete adapted prompt.

Reuse the archived GPT Image sheet and resample its action to nine frames. Sources with eight poses split one held pose across two encoded frames without adding a new pose; longer sequences select nine chronological poses. Preserve total duration and loop settings. Small source cells are enlarged for display without adding detail. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

9 frames, 2 seconds, 362×362px; plays once. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Reviewed all nine-frame sequences in four contact sheets: action order, identity, captions and final poses retained. This output reuses archived GPT Image source pixels; no new provider call. One held pose is split into two frames; eight distinct source poses, nine encoded frames. Total duration and playback count preserved. Original source review (frame counts describe source only): Selected first eight cells: cat looks at camera, winks one eye, then green Robin-labelled hat falls and settles. Discarded final four cells because cat jumps/disappears. Final eight-frame GIF plays once for 2 seconds; no false seamless-loop claim. Text Robin is legible on settled hat.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@ozansihay's original prompt](https://x.com/ozansihay/status/2118238946412953985). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.

zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

按显示顺序上传 1 张本站生成的参考图（R16），使用完整改编词。

复用已生成的 GPT Image 精灵图，统一合成 9 帧：8 姿态素材将一次停留拆成两个编码帧，不新增姿态，较长序列按顺序选取 9 帧。保留总时长与循环设置，小尺寸素材仅放大显示，不增加细节。生图工具返回静态 PNG；GIF 由本地合成。原精灵图、裁切坐标、逐帧时长与首帧封面均保存在批次档案。

## 结果与限制

9 帧，2 秒，362×362 像素，播放一次；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。

原始素材审核说明（以下帧数和尺寸指原始版本；当前交付统一为 9 帧）：保留生成图前 8 格：看镜头、眨眼、写有 Robin 的帽子落下。后 4 格的跳跃和消失未采用；实际播放一次并停在戴帽状态，不宣称无缝循环。

## 来源

由 Prompt Seen 根据 [@ozansihay 的原词](https://x.com/ozansihay/status/2118238946412953985)改编。来源作者称原作品使用 Image 2.6；本次仅确认 GPT Image 家族，精确型号未知。中英文页面保留同一实际提交正文。点赞属于整篇来源帖，同帖变体共享统计对象，不属于本站新作品。
